findings.title: `float: right` on `.small-action button` stops working now that `.small-action` is a flex container
findings.body: `.small-action` was converted to a flex container (`@include flexbox()` at the top of the block). Floats are ignored on flex items, so the `button { float: right; }` declaration inside `.small-action` no longer has any effect: the action button (e.g. the undo/delete control on small post actions) will now be laid out immediately after `.small-action-desc` instead of being pushed to the right edge of the row. The same applies to `.topic-avatar { float: left; }` at line 270, which is now dead. To keep the previous visual result the button should use `margin-left: auto` (and `.small-action-desc` likely needs `flex: 1`).

findings.title: align-items mixin emits invalid legacy values for flex-start/flex-end/stretch
findings.body: The `align-items($alignment)` mixin passes the modern keyword straight through to the 2009 (`-webkit-box-align`) and 2012 (`-ms-flex-align`) properties, but those specs use `start`/`end`/`stretch` rather than `flex-start`/`flex-end`. Any future call such as `@include align-items(flex-start)` will silently produce `-webkit-box-align: flex-start; -ms-flex-align: flex-start;`, which browsers discard, so the legacy fallback the mixin exists to provide will not work while giving the appearance that it does. (Also note `-ms-align-items` on line 121 is not a property implemented by any browser and is pure dead output.) Either map the values inside the mixin or drop the legacy properties.

findings.title: order mixin has an off-by-one between `order` and `box-ordinal-group`
findings.body: `order` is 0-based with an initial value of 0, while `-webkit-box-ordinal-group`/`-moz-box-ordinal-group` are 1-based with an initial value of 1 and reject 0. The mixin forwards `$val` unchanged, so `@include order(0)` emits an invalid `box-ordinal-group: 0`, and `@include order(1)` gives an element the same legacy ordinal group as unordered siblings instead of placing it first. The current call sites (order 2 and 3) happen to still sort correctly, but any use of 0 or 1 will reorder differently in the legacy box model than in modern flexbox. The legacy value should be `$val + 1` (or the legacy properties dropped).

findings.title: Header panel right-alignment relies on auto margins that the legacy box model in the same mixin does not support
findings.body: `.d-header .contents` now gets `display: -webkit-box; display: -moz-box; ...` from `flexbox()`, and `.panel` lost `float: right` in favour of `margin-left: auto` + `order: 3`. In exactly the browsers those legacy `-webkit-box`/`-moz-box` prefixes target, auto margins do not push a box to the end of the main axis (that requires `-webkit-box-pack: end`), so with the float removed the header panel (icons/login buttons) will render left-aligned next to the title instead of on the right. Either add the legacy `box-pack` fallback or remove the 2009 `display` values so those browsers fall back to block layout plus the float.
